our_interpretation: The claim concerns recurring categories of failure across model releases, not identical error rates or failure on every response.
The surrounding text identifies reasoning, hallucination, tool use, controllability, and alignment as relevant categories.
The three-year retrospective supplies the observation period, ending on the post date.
The numerical breadth and universal language remain part of the claim. Evidence from a small sample cannot establish them.
criteria.support_condition: Documented evaluations covering hundreds of distinct models across the named families establish persistence of the listed failure categories throughout the period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible evaluations establish that a model within the claimed population has resolved the relevant core failure categories across varied tasks. Lower error rates alone do not contradict persistence.
